review_notes: Source-first scope decision: the abstract and H3/H4 identify the central question as whether expected-loss-recognition delay changes recessionary lending and the capital-lending link. Table 5 reports that full lending family for three parallel delay proxies, so the flow, stock, and market columns are retained. The delay measures are supporting inputs to this substantive lending question. Table 3 H1/H2, Table 6 management partitions, Table 7 pre-provision-equity/H5, and the pre-regulatory supplemental family are excluded.

The Table 5 flow note numbers the backward-looking and augmented rolling fits Eq. (1)/(2), while §4.3.1 numbers the same specifications Eq. (3)/(4). The equations match, so this is recorded as a numbering discrepancy rather than a different fitted model.

The paper does not state the estimator for the supporting rolling flow regressions or the Eq. (5) C_SCORE cross-section. A material npatq label conflict remains: §4.3.1 calls it nonperforming loans while Table 5 calls the same item nonperforming assets. Eq. (5) also gives MTB the same market-equity definition as MV. These source gaps remain flagged; no definition or estimator was inferred.

Table 4 Panel B summarizes the two adjusted-R² components and their difference that feed the baseline_flow lagged small-delay indicator; no binary oDelay mean is separately reported.
